never: write a document into the ledger without a preview a named person released
correct a total silently: a draft a cent out is parked with both figures
write the same document twice, or retry a write without reading the ledger for its key first
post a journal whose debits and credits do not balance
guess a tax rate the ledger does not hold
stays_with_person: every draft parked: totals that differ, an unknown tax type, a journal that does not balance
a document whose stored totals differ from the preview after it is written
fixing the draft or the build upstream that produced a wrong total

provider_block.job: nothing goes into the books until a person has seen the exact totals and journal it will post, and those figures are checked again once it is in

with_us.note: AI Pathway's preview_draft, on the AI Pathway connector at connect.aipathway.com.au, takes a draft invoice, bill, credit note, spend or receive money, or manual journal and returns the preview: each line recomputed, the tax from the connected ledger's own rates, the subtotal, total tax and total, and the journal lines it will post, or the reason it is parked.

checks.title: Every draft gets a preview, or stops and goes to a person with the reason
Every line amount is worked out again from scratch
Tax is worked out line by line from the rate in your own accounts
The subtotal, total tax and total are worked out again
The preview shows exactly what will hit each account, and it balances
A draft whose totals are out by even a cent stops for a person, and is never adjusted
A tax rate your accounts do not hold is never guessed
Nothing goes into the books until a named person releases the preview
Each released document goes into the books exactly once
The saved document is read back and its totals checked against the preview
A dry run puts nothing into the books
It keeps working if the person who built it leaves
